findings.title: Recorded-model-call attribution lacks support in the supplied sources
findings.page_quote: recorded read mc-c2194c9cd2821519a5511c7fc372d95b agrees with the served value
findings.why: The row records fulltext_verified provenance, but the asserted call ID and its agreement are absent from every supplied review and registry file. The attribution therefore cannot be verified from the permitted content sources.
findings.fix: Record the call attribution and agreement evidence in review.json or a supplied named registry before rendering this claim.

findings.title: J-EMPHASIS-HF registry identifier is incorrectly shown as missing
findings.why: The Registry cell implies no recorded identifier, although the same trial row contains its registry-anchored family ID.
findings.fix: Read family_id when resolving registry identifiers and display NCT01115855.
